beats.vo_text: Nearly eleven thousand meters beneath the Pacific lies Challenger Deep, the deepest point on Earth.
beats.visual_intent: Cinematic underwater drone shot descending into pitch-black deep sea trench, dramatic blue lighting fading into total darkness, eerie atmosphere.

beats.vo_text: In total darkness and crushing pressure, alien-like creatures survive with mesmerizing bioluminescence.
beats.visual_intent: Close-up macro footage of glowing deep-sea jellyfish and siphonophores pulsing with neon blue and green light in the abyss.

beats.vo_text: The water pressure exceeds one thousand atmospheres, equivalent to fifty jumbo jets resting on a human.
beats.visual_intent: Submersible robotic arm operating under extreme hydraulic pressure, deep sea exploration vessel in pitch black water.

beats.vo_text: We know more about the surface of Mars than we do about the mysteries hidden in our own ocean depths.
beats.visual_intent: Split visual concept comparing a brightly lit satellite view of Mars on one side with a murky, unexplored deep ocean trench on the other.
